<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.ScanLineRasterizer: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Converts polygons to a raster: the cells whose center is inside a polygon get a value, the others are novalue. The value is a constant, the one of a field of the polygon, or the one of a raster, which so gets cut by the polygons.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Vector, Rasterize<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.ScanLineRasterizer`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The polygons to rasterize. |
| `pValue` | Double |  |  | The constant value of the cells inside the polygons. If given, it is used instead of the field. |
| `fCat` | String |  |  | The numeric field of the polygons with the value of their cells. |
| `pNorth` | Double |  |  | The north bound of the region to consider |
| `pSouth` | Double |  |  | The south bound of the region to consider |
| `pWest` | Double |  |  | The west bound of the region to consider |
| `pEast` | Double |  |  | The east bound of the region to consider |
| `pRows` | Integer |  |  | The rows of the region to consider |
| `pCols` | Integer |  |  | The cols of the region to consider |
| `pUsePointInPolygon` | Boolean |  | `false` | If true, the slower point in polygon mode is used, for the geometries where the scanline fails. It needs the raster and the constant value. |
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster that gives the grid, instead of bounds, rows and columns; without value and field, also the values of the cells. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The rasterized polygons. |
